info.honesty: A 9-over-21 cross is information, not an entry. UNMEASURED: nothing has measured what follows a cross on these frames.
info.push_text: 👀 Gajjala's Watch marks every 9 / 21 EMA cross on your tickers' 1-, 5- and 15-min charts (closed bars); a cross ABOVE on the latest closed 1-min bar rings once per ticker, frame and session (the 🧠 alert kind) — never pre-market, never the first 15 minutes, never after the extended close, never on a closed day, held under GG's 1,000,000-share session floor. With no trend filter the FIRST up cross after 09:45 uses that ticker's one ring for the day, even inside a down-trend; a later cross is still drawn, not rung. A cross missed by a failed minute read is never sent late. A name also on a ➖ Fade card can ring a second 🔀 from the Fade's 15- or 5-min frame. 5- and 15-min crosses are marked only; a cross under never rings; mode live. UNMEASURED — information, not an entry.
info.uptrend_rule: K5 uptrend: 9 EMA above the 21 EMA and both higher than 3 bars ago
info.auto_text: 🤖 Gajjala's Watch adds, once a minute during the 04:00–20:05 ET pass window, every name that came into a 🧠 potential on the 🚩 5-min and 🧪 boards at any time today with today's volume at or over 1,000,000 shares (GG's K11 floor; the scan row, else the pass's own stored number), up to 18 at a time, in the order added — a current potential first, then today's earlier ones newest first into free seats only (one already ↩️ back under or ✖️ stop printed is not added); an auto name stays all session and leaves when every board reads it ↩️ back under or ✖️ stop printed, or on your ×; at 18 the oldest name whose potential lapsed makes room for a current potential; ⏸ waiting above its trigger stays; a name that becomes 🎯 A+ on any of the 🚩 5-min and 🧪 boards today takes a seat at once, ahead of the potentials (at 18 it displaces the oldest name whose potential lapsed, then the oldest-added potential, never another A+ or your own name) and stays all session — ↩️ back under or ✖️ stop printed never removes it; a name on your 🚫 list never takes a 🤖 auto seat, and a seated potential leaves at the next minute (an A+ seat stays until your ×); your own names are never touched; auto names do not ring the 1-min cross (mode off). UNMEASURED.
info.vwap_text: 📈 VWAP on 👀 Gajjala's Watch: the volume-weighted average price of the regular session (premarket not counted) from 09:30 ET, built from closed 1-min bars (typical price × volume, the house VWAP engine). It restarts every session, stops at the regular close, and its last point is the last closed bar — the live candle does not move it. Display only: nothing gates, sorts or rings on it. UNMEASURED.
info.zones_text: 📐 Daily zones on 👀 Gajjala's Watch: the Supply & Demand engine's daily supply and demand zones (closed daily bars, the board's geometry), the 4 nearest of each kind, drawn dashed where they cross the chart's price range; a zone never moves the price scale. A high or low made in the last 5 closed sessions is not a zone yet — the engine needs 5 later sessions to call it a swing, so yesterday's high is usually not drawn. A name with fewer than 120 daily bars gets none. Display only: nothing gates, sorts or rings on it. UNMEASURED.

auto.hint: Added once a minute in the pass window: every name that came into a 🧠 potential on the 🚩 5-min and 🧪 boards at any time today with today's volume at or over 1,000,000 shares (GG's K11 floor — the scan row, else the pass's own stored number), up to 18. A current potential goes first; today's earlier ones follow newest first, into free seats only, and one that already read ↩️ back under or ✖️ stop printed is not added. A name stays all session; it leaves when every board reads ↩️ back under or ✖️ stop printed, or on your ×; ⏸ waiting above its trigger stays. At 18 the oldest name whose potential lapsed makes room for a current potential. The 🧪 tag means the 🧪 board shows this 🚩 5-min potential (it borrows them). A name that becomes 🎯 A+ on any of these boards today takes a seat at once, ahead of the potentials — at 18 it displaces the oldest name whose potential lapsed, then the oldest-added potential, never another A+ or your own name — and stays all session; ↩️ back under or ✖️ stop printed never remove it (the 🎯 A+ chip says so). Your own names are never touched. Auto names do not ring the 1-min cross. × removes a name until tomorrow. UNMEASURED.
